jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

• Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role is a plus, but junior candidates with the right mindset are also welcome.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Our client is an industrial company.

Jobomschrijving

• Assistance with year-end closing and reporting. Knowledge of both local GAAP and IFRS is required.
• Assistance with the Corporate Income Tax (CIT) calculation, with support from the Tax Manager.
• Handling audit requests for all companies within the audit scope (Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg - 3 companies in total).
• Reviewing the statutory financial statements for all companies within scope.
• Quarterly Board of Directors reporting, including the preparation of local GAAP trial balances (7 entities).

We are looking for a solid and experienced Financial Controller who has:

• Strong knowledge of taxation (Belgian corporate income tax and VAT).
• Good knowledge of local GAAP reporting requirements.
• IFRS knowledge is a strong advantage.
• Experience working in a multinational matrix organization.
• Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP is considered a plus).
• Strong general IT and financial software skills.
• Can work in Dutch and English.

Our client is a Luxembourg-based investment holding company (SOPARFI). They are looking for an Accountant to support the accounting and financial reporting of its holding and financing activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain the general ledger and record daily accounting transactions.
• Account for investments, intercompany loans, interest, dividends and related transactions.
• Perform bank and intercompany reconciliations.
• Prepare periodic closings and annual accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.
• Contribute to IFRS reporting, including adjustments and supporting schedules.
• Monitor cash movements, prepare payments and maintain cash flow forecasts.
• Support tax compliance and any applicable VAT obligations with external advisers.
• Liaise with auditors and maintain complete supporting documentation.

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
• Up to five years of relevant experience, ideally with Luxembourg holding companies or a corporate services provider.
• Working knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and IFRS.
• Familiarity with the accounting treatment of investments and intercompany financing.
• Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting software.
• Accuracy, sound organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with external stakeholders.
• Fluency in French and English.

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Jobomschrijving

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

In your role as a Data Engineer you provide insights and solutions for complex data problems in order to implement end-to-end data solutions. You are responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the Data Warehouse and ETL infrastructure, where you will transform data into useful data formats for analysis. As a Data Engineer you will come across many varied and challenging projects: ranging from the design and implementation of the data warehouse and the development of ETL to the implementation and maintenance of reports and dashboards.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You understand the needs of the customer and can easily handle complex data environments.
• You are focused on collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
• You have strong communication skills and always strive for the best solution.
• You have an inquisitive mind and eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French and have a strong knowledge of English.

WHAT ABOUT YOUR TECHNICAL SKILLS?

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL and Data pipelines to integrate multiple data sources
• Experience with Data Warehouse environments
• Insights in setting up ETL processes and Data Flows
• Development and testing of ETL jobs
• Solid programming skills and SQL querying experience
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools is a plus
• Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball is a plus
• Knowledge of Oracle, Google BigQuery or Microsoft Azure is a plus

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

Client Details

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. 

Description

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Proactively manage and monitor the order portfolio.
• Anticipate potential issues and provide timely solutions to customers.
• Follow up on quotations and contribute to optimal conversion rates.
• Analyze customer data through dashboards and digital tools to determine priorities.
• Deliver personalized and high-quality customer service tailored to different customer segments.
• Collaborate closely with internal departments such as Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Actively contribute to process improvement and digitalization initiatives.
• Work with KPIs and data to continuously optimize service performance.
 

Your Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Initial experience in customer service, sales support, customer experience, or a similar role.
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an advantage.
• Analytical mindset and comfortable working with digital tools and MS Office.
• Customer-oriented, structured, and solution-driven.
• Proactive attitude with the ability to take initiative and think alongside customers and colleagues.
• Comfortable working in an environment where change, innovation, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting. 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.
